dedupe_keys.name: remix energy system optimisation instances for solver benchmarking

description: REMix researchers publish energy-system optimisation instances for solver benchmarking. The collection contains NaGsys European transformation-pathway cases, UNSEEN German power-system scenarios and YSSP German transmission-focused cases. The description states that MPS files omit variable and equation names; a metadata descriptor provides model scope and problem-size information. Eight compressed MPS descriptors and one YAML descriptor are exposed by Zenodo, freely under CC BY 4.0. These are mathematical model instances, not measured grid observations. They support benchmarking solvers used for energy-system optimisation. Coverage includes Europe and Germany, but exact scenario years and every aggregation choice remain unspecified in the inspected description. The related REMix framework generates these models; existing REMix input datasets are not interchangeable with solver-instance files. No MPS body or metadata-file body was downloaded, and numerical solutions or computational performance were not tested.
